policy.baseline: Evaluate the current musical design itself. Never infer quality from source version labels such as v14, v15, or v16.

tempo_design.rule: Choose BPM and energy from the current channel and genre design, then verify the intended role range.

genre_clarity.rule: Front-load one dominant genre and allow at most one compatible secondary tint.

vocal_identity.rule: State a stable recurring singer identity and preserve each track's gender and solo/duet role.

phonation.rule: Specify support, resonance, breath/grain limits, diction, attack and ending behavior without contradictory traits.

groove.rule: Describe pocket, subdivision, syncopation and timing feel as audible behavior.

drums.rule: Name a compact drum language appropriate to the genre; avoid incompatible kit stacks.

bass.rule: Define bass motion, register and rhythmic relationship to kick or backbeat.

instrumentation.rule: Choose a focused palette with one or two signature colors instead of an inventory list.

harmony.rule: Define harmonic motion, chord color or tension/release while avoiding vague mood-only wording.

verse_behavior.rule: Specify verse density, pitch span, rhythmic delivery, rests and phrase attack.

chorus_behavior.rule: Describe a perceptible hook lift while retaining the same vocal identity.

bridge_contrast.rule: Require at least two audible contrast axes; Anchor tracks require at least three.

final_payoff.rule: Design a sustained final payoff; Anchor tracks require strengthened A+B+C or equivalent post section.

prompt_ordering.rule: Order prompt atoms: dominant genre, secondary tint, BPM + groove, singer hard lock, channel phonation / JP-native behavior, rap pocket, drums/bass, focused instrumentation, Hook, Bridge, Final, harmony, short scene/runtime.

redundancy.rule: Collapse repeated synonyms and duplicated instructions into one precise musical behavior.

contradiction.rule: Remove mutually exclusive vocal, energy, genre, instrumentation and positive/exclude instructions.

exclude_efficiency.rule: Use 8-16 short semantic failure-mode categories; retain channel hard-lock protections and remove overlapping wording.

prompt_length.rule: Keep stylePrompt information-dense, normally 120-900 characters and never above 1000.

model_specific_behavior.rule: Adapt syntax only to the explicitly selected target model; do not treat a source JSON version label as a quality signal.

performance_signature.rule: Give each track a concrete, track-specific delivery behavior while retaining the recurring vocal identity.

duration_design.rule: Specify a duration or section-length target appropriate to the song format and avoid premature endings.

generation_hint.rule: Give concise track-specific generation and rejection guidance for the most likely failure mode.

information_density.rule: Detect semantically duplicated prompt atoms and retain each distinct musical instruction only once.

track_specificity.rule: Require a concrete per-track performance cue; recurring singer identity alone is not track specificity.

bridge_specificity.rule: Represent at least two declared audible Bridge change axes in stylePrompt, or three for Anchor tracks.

final_specificity.rule: Reflect the track's highlight payoff in its Final instead of repeating a generic set-wide ending.

template_similarity.rule: Ignore shared singer identity but detect excessive set-wide reuse of groove, instrumentation, performance, Bridge and Final controls.

jp_native_positive_controls.rule: For Japanese vocal channels, actual stylePrompt must positively state close-mic behavior plus JP-native diction, mora timing and natural sentence/pitch-accent behavior; exclusions alone are insufficient.

vocal_design_consistency.rule: Keep stylePrompt and vocalDesign on one recurring channel fingerprint. Do not mix disjoint breath/grain coordinates across fields; express section contrast through phrasing, density and melodic openness instead.

female_voice_isolation.rule: For Female Solo tracks, positive generation fields must use affirmative one-singer female wording only. Keep wrong-gender terms in excludePrompt/negativeStyleText, and replace self-response/self-answer/self-double/vocal-stack cues with identical same-solo-female wording through Final B/Post-Chorus.
